name: Unleashed Recompiled
description:
UnleashedRecomp is an enhanced native PC port of the high-speed platformer Sonic Unleashed, created using static recompilation. It brings Sonic's daytime daytime boost stages and nighttime brawling natively to PC.

Features:
- Native execution delivering smooth 60+ FPS high-speed gameplay without emulation lag
- True widescreen and 4K display rendering with modern aspect ratio scaling
- Full gamepad controller support with responsive analog stick and trigger inputs
- High-fidelity audio playback reproducing the orchestral soundtrack and sound effects
- Support for community performance patches, visual enhancements, and mods
